input.prompt: A new object from the same stadium as the floodlight tower in image[1]: one flat section of a stadium's outside wall, a little taller than wide, like one tile of a repeating wall. A thick square concrete column with riveted steel bands runs up the left edge and one up the right edge, exactly alike. Between them a weathered concrete wall: at the bottom one wide round arched gateway with a pitch black inside, above it one tall plain white blank cloth banner hanging flat on the wall between two steel brackets, above that a row of three small dark windows, and along the top a heavy grey steel cornice. Flat, shallow, perfectly left-right symmetrical. Straight-on front view. Whole object in frame, single isolated object on a plain grey background, in exactly the stylized hand-painted game prop style, weathered concrete and grey riveted steel colours and lighting of image[1]. No people, no text, no logos.
